$comment: Shared cases for the strict hand-back check (plan deviation d3). Generated by scripts/strict_vectors.ts, which runs the extension's own runStrict with a fake decider returning each case's stored answers; held byte-identical in evidence-cli. The shape is described in docs/notes/strict-vectors.md. Do not edit by hand: change the inputs in the script and regenerate.

cases.name: cascade_from_unchecked_fact
cases.note: An unchecked fact (no saved text, a partial result) counts as failed in the cascades run with the decider: what rests on it is dropped naming it as the root, also through a chain. A derived fact on it is never sent; a worded fact on it is sent first, and keeps its answer.

cases.name: read_stamps_mixed_lines
cases.note: A stamped read result: both ends of lines must be shown stamps, the lines between are taken by position (unstamped ones too); a search that finds an unstamped line reports its position. A read result whose first line has no stamp, and any other tool's result, is counted by position even when later lines look stamped.

cases.name: read_stamps_cut_result
cases.note: A stamped read result that was cut: lines before the last kept line are copied; the last kept line, a stamp above the last shown one, or a term not found is result_cut; a stamp below the shown ones is pointer_out_of_range.
